note: Live heartbeat for the board. Fixed before the first live run. Same decision rule as data/heartbeat-params.json v1 (K, N, 28-day hour-of-day baseline, median >= 4) - only the inputs are extended to more chains.
hot_set: every address listed for the exchange in data/registry/<exchange>.json (same no-selection rule as the backtests)
own_set: hot set on all chains + explorer labels of the exchange (Ethereum, eth-labels@d9b21ae, exploit labels excluded)

chains.ethereum: native ETH + the 13 allow-listed ERC-20s of heartbeat-params.json, from the hot set to outside the own set (Etherscan V2)
chains.tron: USDT-TRC20 (TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t, DefiLlama coreAssets) from the hot set to outside the own set (TronGrid v1, only_from=true)
chains.bsc: native BNB transfers (category external, value > 0, receipt status 1) + BEP-20 transfers of the allow-listed tokens below, from the hot set to outside the own set (NodeReal nr_getAssetTransfers)

signal: hourly count summed over the chains that have data
window: the 29 UTC days before the last full hour (28 for the baseline + 1 to show)

states.normal: current hour has a usable baseline (median >= 4) and no alarm
states.below_usual_pattern: the v1 alarm rule holds at the last full hour (N consecutive stall hours)
states.not_enough_data: median of the baseline for the current hour < 4 - shown as such, never as normal

copy_rule: UI says 'below its usual pattern', never a claim about solvency (CLAUDE.md invariant 2)
v2_change: BSC added before any BSC data was fetched. Free public BSC RPCs refuse eth_getLogs history or cap it at ~100 blocks (probed 11 Oct: bsc-dataseed, publicnode, 1rpc, dRPC free), so BSC uses NodeReal MegaNode nr_getAssetTransfers (free plan, archive data).
